items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 唷，找本堂主有何贵干呀？嗯？你不知道吗，往生堂第七十七代堂主就是胡桃我啦！嘶，不过瞧你的模样，容光焕发，身体健康，嗯…想必是为了工作以外的事来找我，对吧？
items.text_en: Yoh, now why might you be looking for me, hm? Oh, you didn't know? I'm the 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao. Though by the looks of you... Radiant glow, healthy posture... Yes, you're definitely here for something other than that which falls within my regular line of work, aren't you?

items.title: 闲聊·往生堂
items.text: 不如去我那儿喝杯茶？嘿~
items.text_en: Wanna come over for tea?

items.title: 闲聊·客户
items.text: 一个客户，两个客户，三个客户…
items.text_en: One client, two clients, three clients!

items.title: 闲聊·偷懒
items.text: 咳咳…太阳出来我晒太阳，月亮出来我晒月亮咯~
items.text_en: When the sun's out, bathe in sunlight. But when the moon's out, bathe in moonlight~

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 哎呀…麻烦喽。
items.text_en: *sigh* What a bummer...

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 打雷啦，起身啦。
items.text_en: Lightning! Let's bolt!

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 哇，是雪！
items.text_en: Snow!

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 嗯，真舒服。
items.text_en: Ahhhh~ What a nice breeze~

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 欸？…唉，帽子都要吹飞了。
items.text_en: My hat's gonna get blown away!

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 嗯~早起身体好，晚睡人会飘。
items.text_en: Well are those who rise in the early morn, while those late to bed I shall forewarn~

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 哟！中午好呀，吃了吗？
items.text_en: Yo! Afternoon! Had lunch?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 嘻嘻，月亮出来喽~咱也出门吧。
items.text_en: Hee-hee, moon's out, and so am I!

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 哦，困了吗？那你好好休息，我一个人四处转转。
items.text_en: Oh, you sleepy? Get some rest, I'm gonna take a walk by myself...

items.title: 关于胡桃自己·名字
items.text: 胡桃的胡是胡吃海喝的胡，胡桃的桃却不是淘气的淘！嘿嘿…不、不好笑吗？
items.text_en: Hu as in "Who put me in this coffin?" and Tao as in "I can't geT OUt!" Hehe... No, not funny?

items.title: 关于胡桃自己·拿手好戏
items.text: 变个戏法给你看，瞧好了哦…火！然后…嚯！火蝴蝶！呼，飞啦——哈哈。
items.text_en: Lemme show you some fire tricks. First... Fire! And then... Whoosh! Fire butterfly! Be free!

items.title: 关于我们·好奇心
items.text: 你到处旅行，一定见多识广。有空也给我讲讲你自己的故事吧。
items.text_en: You've been all over, so you must've seen a lot. When you've got the time, tell me your story, yea?

items.title: 关于我们·夜晚
items.text: 白天你尽管到处跑，晚上可得小心点。我不在的时候，务必谨慎行动。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Run around all you like during the day, but you should be careful during the night. When I'm not around, best keep your wits about you.

items.title: 关于我们·帮手
items.text: 需要帮手吗？需要帮手吗？我来啦！若你需要帮助，胡桃我定当全力以赴，绝不推辞。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Need a hand, need a hand? I'm here! If you need some assistance, I'm here to give it my all to the very end! Hee-hee...

items.title: 关于我们·战斗
items.text: 战斗是件麻烦事，对我来说，它不是目的而是手段。用手段来达到目的，用战斗来维护不愿让步的东西。就这方面而言，我和你是一样的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Fighting's a pain. For me, it's not an objective so much as a means to an end. Using the means to reach the end, to fight for that which I will not compromise on — it's in this way that you and I are the same.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」…「神之眼」？唔，这东西，随缘就好。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Vision... Vision...? Oh, this thing? Yeah, whatever...

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 受人之托，忠人之事。我们往生堂性质特殊，肩负着双倍责任，所以，一定要让两个世界的人都满意才行。
items.text_en: We are entrusted by the people to loyally see out their wishes. Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is special, in that it carries a dual responsibility, to those both of this realm, and the next.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 有些花草只长在阴气重月光多的地方，你见过吗？没有？那下次带你见识见识。
items.text_en: Some plants only grow in gloomier spots with ample moonlight. You ever seen any? Oh, no? Well, I'll have to show you next time.

items.title: 关于钟离
items.text: 钟离长得那么年轻，性格倒像是个老古董，什么都懂，却什么都不关心，他该不会…？嘻嘻…唉，算了，随他去吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Zhongli looks young, but his personality is a bit dusty. Knows everything, but doesn't fret over anything. Hmm... Couldn't be that he's a...Hehe, forget it, whatever.

items.title: 关于七七
items.text: 看到七七了吗？快告诉我她在哪，我要把她藏起来，嘿！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Have you seen Qiqi? Tell me where she is, quickly. I need to go seal her away, hee-hee!

items.title: 关于白术
items.text: 白术？哼，麻烦的家伙。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Baizhu? Ugh, that guy...

items.title: 关于凝光
items.text: 天权凝光，富甲一方；明眸善睐，桃羞杏让；目达耳通，百了千当！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Tianquan Ningguang... Well-off, a radiant gaze, exquisite face, in the know and capable of anything!

items.title: 关于北斗
items.text: 北斗姐可是璃月名人，她不认识我没关系，我认识她就行。啊~真想和她交个朋友啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Beidou is well-known in Liyue. She doesn't know me, but that's cool, me just knowing about her is enough. Aw man... I really do wanna make friends with her.

items.title: 关于行秋
items.text: 听说行秋少爷在写书？话本还是怪谈呢？好想把平日遇见的杂事说给他听，写成书一定很好看吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I hear master Xingqiu is writing a book? Standard novella, or a ghost story? I think I should go tell him about all the things I run into — that'd make for a really good read!

items.title: 关于重云
items.text: 纯阳正气，阴阳合一？啧啧，嘶…没想到世上真有这种体质的人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4All yang and no yin? Huh, who knew such people existed in this world?

items.title: 关于魈
items.text: 仙家的事，我怎么知道？哎呀呀，天机不可泄露。你就别问我啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4What would I know of the adepti? Ai-yai-yai, that kind of stuff is top-secret! Don't come asking me about it!

items.title: 关于刻晴
items.text: 「玉衡」刻晴啊，嘶…是个很难打交道的人呢。嘿嘿，瞧那一本正经的样子，真想逗逗她。哎呦，她应该不会用剑敲我头吧？不会的吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Yuheng, Keqing... she's quite hard to talk to. She's so uptight, hehe... Really makes me wanna mess with her. She wouldn't knock me in the head with her sword though, right? Or would she...?

items.title: 关于香菱
items.text: 香菱可好玩了，一碰就跳，特别容易被唬住。做我们这行，最喜欢这种人喽。不过也得注意分寸，毕竟，锅巴会替香菱出头呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Xiangling's a riot! Only a little "boo" and she jumps, she's so easy to scare! Being in the industry that I am, I just love these kinds of people the most. Gotta keep it in check though, in case Guoba ends up toasting me instead.

items.title: 关于云堇
items.text: 云堇她在正式场合很优雅，私底下却非常容易亲近哦！上次我跟她打了个赌，输的人要用自己习惯的唱法唱对方填的词。哎呀呀，戏腔版的丘丘谣，你真该听一次！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Yun Jin always appears so graceful on formal occasions, but you'd be surprised how friendly she is in private! I made a bet with her once, and the loser had to sing lyrics of the winner's choice in their own singing style. My my, I wish you could have heard her operatic version of the Hilitune!

items.title: 关于申鹤
items.text: 她可真是个有意思的人呐，跟别人都不一样。你说，要是我从现在开始天天吃仙草、喝山露，会不会也变成她那么不染红尘的样子？嘿嘿…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She is quite the fascinating individual, completely different from anyone else I've encountered. Do you think if I started eating divine herbs and drinking the dew of the mountains every single day, I'd be able to look as pure and pristine as she does? Hehe...

items.title: 想要了解胡桃·其一
items.text: 大丘丘病了，二丘丘瞧；三丘丘采药，四丘丘熬；五丘丘死了，六丘丘抬~欸…呼。
items.text_en: ♪Silly-churl, billy-churl, silly-billy hilichurl. Frilly-churl, willy-churl, frilly-willy hilichurl♪ Ah, hehe...

items.title: 想要了解胡桃·其二
items.text: 小巷派暗黑打油诗人，正是本人！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Versemonger of the darkest alleys — that's me!

items.title: 想要了解胡桃·其三
items.text: 若要我说，往生堂的工作既不困难也不可怕，只是麻烦而已。可惜旁人理解不了，见到咱们夜里出工，总是有些惧怕。唉，是他们不懂啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4If you ask me, there's nothing hard or scary about working at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, it's just a pain is all. It's a shame — others see us going out to work at night and just don't understand — and that's what scares them. *sigh* You all just don't understand!

items.title: 想要了解胡桃·其四
items.text: 我是「往生堂」第七十七代堂主，我爷爷是第七十五代。我经手的第一份工作，就是替爷爷办葬礼。是不是很意外啊？哎呀，不知不觉就在这行做了好些年，时间过得可真快。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5I'm Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's 77th Funeral Director, my grandfather was the 75th. First thing I took over was funeral affairs. Haha, surprising huh? And just like that, it's already been a few years... Time really does go by so quickly.

items.title: 想要了解胡桃·其五
items.text: 阴阳有序，命运无常。死亡难以预测，却也有它的规矩。记住了，无论何时何地，无论有何原因，人都不该轻易挑衅「死」之一事。唯有认识它、尊重它，才能明白活着的价值。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Balance must be maintained, and yet destinies remain variable. Death has its own rules, and yet is still hard to predict. Remember — no matter where, no matter when, no matter what the reason — one should never poke fun at death. Only once you know and respect death can you truly understand the value of life.

items.title: 胡桃的爱好
items.text: 天清海阔，皓月凌空，此情此景，正适合作诗一首。
items.text_en: A bright moon aloft amid the vast, clear skies... Moments like these are just perfect for writing poetry.

items.title: 胡桃的烦恼
items.text: 唉…真想找些新乐子，无所事事比死亡可怕多了。
items.text_en: *sigh* I gotta find something fun to do... Sitting around doing nothing is a fate worse than death.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: ♪啦啦啦啦~吃水煮鱼配虾饺啦~
items.text_en: ♪La~la~la~ Steamed fish with a side of prawn dumplings~

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 清心炒史莱姆凝液…呕…这是香菱对我的复仇吗？
items.text_en: Qingxin Slime Condensate... Bleugh... Surely this is Xiangling getting payback...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 甚好甚好。本堂主现在就来为这道菜肴题诗一首——
items.text_en: Splendid, splendid! Now, allow me to compose a poem in loving memory of this dish.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 真不用我来帮忙吗？做一道送一道哦！
items.text_en: Sure you don't want my help? C'mon, it's a great deal: cook twice the amount in the same time!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 噫…这是什么东西呀？
items.text_en: Ugh, I declare this dish dead, rest in peace.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 今夜天星璀璨，月相壮丽，想必是个好日子。嘶，待我一算…嗯~我知道我知道，是你的生辰！哎呀，真是个好日子。
items.text_en: Tonight the stars are dazzling and the moon majestic, it must be a special day... But just what day could it be... Haha, I know, I know! It's your birthday! It really is a great day.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 哦呀？哦呀呀？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1O-ya? O-ya-ya-ya?

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 嗯~真不错，谢啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Yeah, this is good, thanks!

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 没想到没想到，胡桃我现在力如泉涌，心似雄鹰，非常有自信哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4I never imagined that I, Hu Tao, could ever be like this. Energy like a rushing torrent, a heart soaring like a gliding eagle! I feel great!

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 力量若达到极限，接着考验的便是人心。多亏了你，我才能来到这片未曾踏足的领域。在这里，心和灵魂就像一片云彩…生老病死，天地万象，尽在吾辈。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6If I reach my full physical potential, then the next test is of the heart. It's largely thanks to you that I've been able to step foot into this uncharted territory. It is here that heart and soul are as one like clouds. Death is a constant for all among the multitudes that sit beneath the heavens.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 喝!
items.text_en: Huh!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 起！
items.text_en: Chi!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 散!
items.text_en: Suh!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 吃饱喝饱，一路走好！
items.text_en: Time to go!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 再会啦！
items.text_en: Cross over!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 蝶火燎原！
items.text_en: Pyre, pyre, pants on fire!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text_en: Huyoh!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 走~
items.text_en: Go~

items.title: 冲刺开始·其三
items.text: 咻~
items.text_en: Hyu~

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 顺风顺水~
items.text_en: With the wind~

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 撞大运咯！
items.text_en: Jackpot!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 让我看看，都有什么好东西。
items.text_en: What a cute treasure coffin!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 快埋进土里，等它长出好多宝箱！
items.text_en: If we bury it, maybe it'll spring back to life!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 哎哟哎哟！
items.text_en: Ayaya!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text_en: Eeeeeee!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 糟糕！
items.text_en: This isn't good!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 悠着点！
items.text_en: Take it easy!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 放着我来！
items.text_en: Lemme have a go!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 到我了吗…
items.text_en: Is it... my time?

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 我记…仇…
items.text_en: I'll remember that...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 呃啊——
items.text_en: Argh...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 干嘛呀！
items.text_en: Quit it!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 哦？该我出马了？
items.text_en: Oh? Is it time for me to join you?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 你很有眼光嘛！
items.text_en: Good eye!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 一波送走，全送走。
items.text_en: Send one, send 'em all!
